description: This file defines the core runtime logic for a voice call plugin, including configuration resolution, provider setup, tunnel and exposure management, webhook server initialization, and runtime lifecycle management.

classes.name: VoiceCallRuntime
classes.description: Represents the runtime environment for a voice call plugin, including configuration, provider, manager, webhook server, URLs, and a stop method.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Logging interface with methods for info, warn, error, and optional debug messages.

classes.name: ResolvedRealtimeProvider
classes.description: Holds the resolved realtime voice provider plugin and its configuration.

methods.name: createRuntimeResourceLifecycle
methods.description: Creates lifecycle management functions for tunnel result setting and stopping resources, including cleanup of tunnel, tailscale exposure, and webhook server.

methods.name: isLoopbackBind
methods.description: Checks if a given bind address is a loopback address.

methods.name: resolveProvider
methods.description: Resolves and instantiates a voice call provider based on configuration, supporting multiple provider types.

methods.name: resolveRealtimeProvider
methods.description: Resolves and configures a realtime voice provider based on configuration and available providers.

methods.name: createVoiceCallRuntime
methods.description: Main function to initialize and run the voice call runtime, including configuration validation, provider setup, tunnel/exposure setup, webhook server, and lifecycle management.
